source_contract.domain_selection: select source_nodes whose frozen domain identity is Domain II, preserving source order and exact source identity

batching.rule: No node may be omitted, duplicated, renamed, or moved to another frozen requirement identity. The exact selected node IDs must be emitted into each candidate before validation.

candidate_requirements.prerequisite_edges: Only admit an edge when a concrete source-bound or Learning-owner provisional rationale and evidence reference are present; otherwise emit an unresolved dependency candidate.
candidate_requirements.subskills: Each provisional subskill must bind to exactly one frozen parent requirement, include a capability statement and derivation class accepted by Validator 003, and have a matching decomposition edge.
candidate_requirements.unresolved_dependency_candidates: Uncertain cross-node or cross-domain relations remain UNRESOLVED__NOT_CANONICAL and are not silently admitted.
candidate_requirements.acyclicity: The admitted prerequisite graph must remain acyclic after every bounded batch.
candidate_requirements.resolvability: Every admitted edge endpoint and every subskill parent must resolve to the frozen source index or the candidate's valid provisional subskill set.

evidence_target: all 23 frozen Domain II source nodes receive exactly one bounded-batch disposition
each changed candidate has an exact candidate SHA/digest and Validator 003 result
all admitted prerequisite/decomposition edges are resolvable and acyclic
uncertain relations remain explicit unresolved candidates
no newer ASQ revision, SME approval, learner outcome, certification, native, A-01, or production evidence is inferred
successor_instruction: Materialize the first source-order batch of at most five exact frozen Domain II nodes from the 66-node source index; add only evidence-bound provisional subskill/decomposition/prerequisite structure; leave uncertain relations unresolved; run Validator 003 against the exact candidate; preserve the exact candidate identity and evidence; then continue batch 02 rather than stopping if time remains.
